comment: SGI's feedback loop runs from consuming applications back into the governance cycle. It does not yet include feedback from care outcomes and receiver comprehension — e.g. terms or models that are systematically misread at the point of care.

reviewer.name: Gerard Freriks and Angelo Rossi-Mori
reviewer.organisation: Gerard Freriks is Affilated with CEN and ISO

public.text: SGI's feedback loop runs from consuming applications back into the governance cycle. It does not yet include feedback from care outcomes and receiver comprehension — e.g. terms or models that are systematically misread at the point of care.
public.suggestedRevision: Add to the SGI capability categories (and Appendix F) a capability for pragmatic feedback: structured intake of evidence that governed content is misinterpreted or fails to support appropriate action in practice, feeding the authoring/publication cycle.
